method: Compare the existing public-mean Taylor expansion with closed-form per-channel 2x2 ridge affine coefficients from the same pinned public calibration. No pretrained gate/up/down weight changes, gradient fitting, or private-prompt data. Fixed ridge ratio is 0.001. Selected original channels retain their original nonlinear arithmetic. No extra online data are needed at a given channel width.

decision: An analytic public fit can improve an isolated last-layer prefill without altering original weights, but no checked calibration method improves the three-layer 128-channel 5/12 prefill and 9/12 decode result. Decision-row-only fitting overfits, and a broad cohort plus public decode rows does not recover quality. Do not promote as a 10x whole-model path. Compare novel source-preserving methods only on a fresh held-out cohort rather than selecting from these repeated diagnostics.
limitations: Twelve prompts are a narrow same-token and one-step-feedback diagnostic, not generation quality.
Profile digests bind public calibration rows and the affine method; no private-prompt calibration is admissible.
All byte figures are unimplemented two-worker logical cut projections; full wire, attention, head, numeric ring, cold model distribution and matched compute are unmeasured.
